rows.text: Thank you so much, esteemed guest... I notice that you have already obtained the target mentioned in the prophecy.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: There must be other blessed nymphs in other areas. Esteemed guest, try taking a look around other Garmentmakers.
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Esteemed guest, there are no more nymphs left here — you're just too amazing!
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: There should be still more nymphs elsewhere. Why not lend a hand to my fellow Garmentmakers? Allow me to thank you on their behalf!
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker
